const field = Symbol("field");

class Fields {
  fn = (function () {});
  arrow = ((() => 1));
  cls = (class { static recorded = this.name; });
  explicit = (function Explicit() {});
  #private = (() => 1);
  [field] = ((class Inner {}));
  static ["get"] = ((() => 1));
  static [field] = (class {});
  f() { return this.#private.name; }
}
const value = new Fields();
console.log(value.fn.name, value.arrow.name, value.cls.name, value.cls.recorded);
console.log(value.explicit.name, value.f(), value[field].name, Fields.get.name, Fields[field].name);
